create_dataloader_imagenet: create PyTorch DataLoaders for ImageNet training and validation with configurable batch size and transforms
create_dataloader_cifar: create PyTorch DataLoaders for CIFAR-10 or CIFAR-100 datasets with optional Cutout augmentation and noise
create_dataloader_ddp: create distributed PyTorch DataLoaders using DistributedSampler for multi-GPU training with DistributedDataParallel
convert_to_few_shot: convert a torchvision dataset to a few-shot learning dataset with N samples per class
create_dataloader_custom_transforms: create PyTorch DataLoaders with custom train and validation transforms passed as a tuple
